### Sit Down and Be Seen By Jesus
Author: Shawn McEvoy
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/sit-down-and-be-seen-by-jesus-bible-study-minute-january-8-2019.html
Passage: Matthew 5:1-2
Points:
- Jesus moved up the mountainside and sat down among the crowd before beginning to speak.
- The opening of the Sermon on the Mount shows Christ directly seeing and engaging the varied people gathered before Him.
- Rather than presenting a list of burdensome commands, Jesus acknowledged the real-life struggles of His listeners.
- Whatever vulnerability or brokenness brings people to the feet of Jesus is seen by Him and met with blessing.
